model.label: Expected points
model.desc: Multinomial LightGBM next-score model (TD, FG, safety, none and the opponent's) on down, distance, field position, time, score, timeouts, home, roof and era; cross-fitted by season. EPA = EP after - EP before. Compared with nflfastR's EP on the Calibration page.

model.label: Win probability
model.desc: Our own win-probability model on score, time, field position, down and distance, timeouts and the pre-game spread; compared with nflfastR's and ESPN's on every game page.

model.label: Fourth-down decisions
model.desc: Win probability of going for it, punting and kicking: conversion probability, punt net distance and field-goal make probability feed the WP model; the decision's grade is the WP lost against the best option.

model.label: Completion probability (CPOE)
model.desc: P(completion) from air yards, target depth and location, pressure and (FTN) charting; CPOE = completions minus expected.

model.label: Expected YAC
model.desc: Expected yards after the catch at the catch point; YACOE = actual - expected.

model.label: Rush yards over expected
model.desc: Expected rushing yards from box count, down, distance, field position and formation (FTN / participation where available); NGS RYOE shown 2016 onward.

model.label: Gridiron Value
model.desc: EPA attributed to passers, rushers and receivers (receivers credited with the air and YAC split), adjusted for opponent and supporting cast by ridge (RAPM-style) where participation exists.

model.label: QB composite
model.desc: EPA per dropback, CPOE, sack avoidance and turnover-worthy plays, each shrunk at its stabilisation rate, combined to 100 = average, 10 = one SD.

model.label: Kicking
model.desc: Field-goal make probability by distance, weather, altitude and roof; FG over expected.

model.label: Team strength
model.desc: Opponent-adjusted unit ratings (pass and rush offence and defence, special teams) with time decay and priors, a separate QB component, in points per game against an average team.

model.label: Game model
model.desc: Expected margin and total from team strength, home field (by season), rest, travel, time zones, weather and QB status; win, spread and total distributions with drive-level simulation.

model.label: Season simulation
model.desc: The remaining schedule simulated with the game model, the NFL tiebreakers and the seven-team conference playoffs with reseeding; division, playoff, bye and Super Bowl odds, magic numbers and draft order.

model.label: Award races
model.desc: MVP, OPOY, DPOY, OROY, DROY, CPOY and COTY from model value and voting features, fitted on a verified table of past winners.

model.label: EPA units
model.desc: Opponent-adjusted EPA per play by unit: a ridge regression of play EPA on offence and defence indicators (penalty 60 plays per team).

model.label: Go rate over expected
model.desc: A coach's fourth-down go rate minus a league logistic model's expected go rate in the same situations (distance, field position, score, time, win probability), fitted per season.

model.label: Percentiles
model.desc: 100 = best, reversed where lower is better; placed against the position group's reference pool after shrinking the value toward the pool mean with the metric's stabilisation constant ((n v + k m) / (n + k)); a metric needs its sample floor (50 dropbacks, 30 carries, 15 targets, 5 FG attempts, 10 punts) to get one. pct_pos compares within the listed position (defence: DL, LB, DB).

model.label: Stabilisation
model.desc: The sample at which split-half reliability reaches 0.7: r(n) = n / (n + k), n_0.7 = 0.7 k / 0.3, k fitted per metric over seasons (our stabilise.py; published values where not fitted).

model.label: Era adjustment
model.desc: History leaderboards rank season rates as z-scores within their own season's qualified pool (shown as 100 + 10 z), so 2007 and 2024 passing are compared against their own league.
